what_is_closed: the IHEP 2001-32 primary report is archived with a reproducible local hash
the ATOMGRAPH TPG in-plane and averaged TPG out-of-plane rows are source-locked with ranges and uncertainty
the hexagonal alpha_V relation and zero-covariance comparator propagation are deterministic
the mixed-row and non-Ding material boundary is retained instead of being promoted

equation_or_mapping.uncertainty_propagation: u(alpha_V) = sqrt((2*u(alpha_a))^2 + u(alpha_c)^2), zero covariance assumed only for comparator output
equation_or_mapping.temperature_scope: source slopes over 25-60 deg C; not an exact 300 K point

units.temperature: deg C source range and K mirror

major_result.derivation_class: source transcription plus anisotropic thermodynamic geometry conversion; no UET derivation
major_result.observable: TPG alpha_a, alpha_c, and family-level alpha_V comparator
major_result.dependency_unlocked: declared TPG anisotropic alpha_V comparator lane only; no same-grade K_T, Ding C_src, alpha_Phi_K, transport, Core, Gravity, or Galaxy unlock
major_result.claim_boundary: This closes only a source-traceable TPG family-level alpha_V comparator. It is not a same-specimen volumetric measurement, not a Ding TTG match, not a complete Cp-to-Cv correction, and not an alpha_Phi_K calibration.

source.title: Quasi Mono-Crystal Pyrolitic Graphite Samples
source.publisher: State Research Center of Russia, Institute for High Energy Physics
source_locators: PDF printed p. 1: TPG and HOPG sample identities and measured directions
PDF printed pp. 4-5: ATOMGRAPH TPG in-plane alpha value and uncertainty
PDF printed pp. 6-7: averaged TPG out-of-plane alpha value, uncertainty, and 25-60 deg C scope
PDF printed pp. 7-9: material-form comparison and conclusion boundary
source.measurement_method: optical-lever displacement measurement with Pt100 temperature sensors and copper reference calibration
source.material_scope: thermal pyrolytic graphite (TPG) from Advanced Ceramics and ATOMGRAPH; the out-of-plane row is an averaged TPG result
source.preprocessing: byte-preserving PDF archive; scalar row transcription; deg C range retained and mirrored in K metadata; anisotropic alpha_V propagation with no covariance supplied; no figure digitization, interpolation, fitting, target-curve access, or holdout access

source_row.row_identity: ATOMGRAPH TPG in-plane slope paired with the report's averaged TPG out-of-plane slope
source_row.temperature_scope: source-reported slope range; not an exact 300 K point
source_row.uncertainty_interpretation: source-reported uncertainties for the two linear rows; covariance and same-specimen covariance are not supplied

derived_comparator.alpha_V_uncertainty_method: sqrt((2*0.11e-6)^2 + (0.4e-6)^2), zero covariance assumed only for this comparator
